A '''''tarnuur''''' was a title awarded by the [[Gand/Legends|Gand]] to members of their kind and others who had shown a commitment to friendship.

During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Yuun (Gand)|Yuun]] informed the new [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of [[Havoc Squad]] that he considered them to be their ''tarnuur''. As a result, Yuun was dedicated to follow the leader of the squad with whoever they classed as friend being a friend of the Gand, with their family being protected to the same capacity as if they were Yuun's own family.
